status: Partial Shell implementation; not a completed port.

19.3.0.movement: Two five-part chains fly diagonally and reflect off walls; nearby heads steer slightly toward the player. Exposed attached flesh slows the chain and loses flight. Detached flesh groups chase slowly; single flesh pieces are stationary.
19.3.0.targeting: Head proximity steering; exposed middle pieces aim a three-shot volley at player, end pieces spawn Fly Bombs.
19.3.0.attacks: Contact damage, aimed triples from exposed middle sections, independent Fly Bomb offspring from exposed ends. Armor and heads do not shoot.
19.3.0.vulnerability: Invulnerable head; body has 15 independent explosive armor, then source base 35 flesh HP. No documented Tuff explosive resistance. Terra and rock waves are named armor exceptions; Sulfuric Acid is not. Repentance+ Hagalaz excluded.
19.3.0.phases: Armor to grounded flesh; destroyed bodies partition contiguous chains. A sufficiently long headless piece with an armored endpoint promotes it; short armored fragments retire, flesh survives independently. A head with no attached body dies.
19.3.0.offspring: Two heads plus eight body segments, one or two Bomb Grimaces, normal Fly Bombs from exposed ends. Same 19.3.0 source identity represents all parts.
19.3.0.completion: Both original chains and detached flesh must be gone; ordinary offspring still gate room clearance.

adaptations.health: 35 * 3.2 = 112 per body; 15 armor stays literal. Invulnerable heads excluded from initial 896 aggregate health. Promoted heads cease contributing killable HP; no hidden healing or new body is created.
adaptations.damage: Actual explosion provenance; no spillover into flesh on stripping hit. No Tuff reduction or speed bonus. Base contact/shot 10 uses existing hostile multiplier. Debug deletion is distinct from ordinary execution.
adaptations.motion: Local 3.5 units/s diagonal flight; proximity range 6, turn rate .35 rad/s constrained within .3 radians of the current diagonal; up to 60% exposed slowdown. Detached flesh .8 units/s. Spacing 1.55, followers up to 1.5x leader speed, cached routes .6 seconds, bounded 1024-point trail.
adaptations.landing: Vulnerable flesh slides to connected safe floor before descending at local 5 units/s. Bounded 24-radius/16-spoke search cached for 1 second; falls back to its safe spawn home. No teleport, deletion, or attack while settling. No rigid physical tether is imposed on mixed flying/grounded chains.
adaptations.topology: Reconcile only after entire queued damage batch. Original-headed contiguous branch retained unless its head is alone. Headless >=3 piece with armored endpoint promotes that endpoint (reverse order when only rear eligible); remaining armored pieces auto-retire, flesh remains in contiguous groups. Auto-retire does not emit kill/loot events; all ordinary body deaths retain existing kill accounting. Newly promoted heads snap to the inherited diagonal quadrant, so a follower cardinal route cannot turn the new head into a cardinal flyer.
adaptations.attacks: Local end spawn 5 seconds, room child cap 4 including queued Fly Bombs, middle triple 2.8 seconds, speed8, spread .22 radians. Detached group uses last member as spawning end; first headless member still fires triples. Exact native endpoint selection unconfirmed.
adaptations.arena: Standard Broken Quarry, boss pool weight1 based on Ashpit pool identity96. One room axis doubled; actual room extents repacked to keep roads/passages separated, room counts unchanged. Two mandatory opposite suppliers preflight atomically. No ordinary/tutorial/Mine/hub additions.
adaptations.completion: One aggregate boss reward, original-part projectiles cancelled, offspring stay alive until killed. Chains pause in inactive rooms and survive re-entry.
adaptations.presentation: Original rendering, procedural ivory skull/rib armor and red grounded flesh; no imported Isaac artwork.

unknowns: Exact native speed, steering, timings, spacing, projectile tuning, child cap and armor spillover are unmeasured.
Contiguous split interpretation, endpoint reversal, retained old-head branch and automatic retirement accounting need native edge-case comparison.
Terra and item-created rock-wave armor stripping are source-supported but their item producers remain missing; generic piercing/area/execution must not impersonate them.
3D cover/water landing and follower routing are local policies; real double arenas are flat, but stress geometry still needs acceptance.
Greed, Void, special boss-challenge routes and named status/item interactions remain open.
Human/varied-build balance, all-camera readability and controlled Linux/WASM performance acceptance remain open.
